{{Top|leg}}
'''Adarlon Universal Ordinance 071.873''' was a law on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. Sub-section 111.841 absolved businesses from bearing responsibility for their customers' foolhardiness. This law allowed the [[Glow Dome]] to not be responsible for any patron with sensitive [[Eye/Legends|ocular organs]] who looked directly at the bright lights within without protection.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
